body.name: aggregate-projector, positive-moment, and local-score handle
body.construction: For positive-law repair, start from Bauer--Fike localization of the empirical compressed operator, replace individual eigenvectors inside overlapping discs by Kato contour projectors, and transport aggregate projector mass only across each cluster diameter.  At the realized empirical summary only, let \(m=(m_j)_{0\le j<2k}\) be its first \(2k\) spectral moments and choose a valid positive \(k\)-atomic law \(\sum_i w_i\delta_{x_i}\) that globally minimizes the \(L^1\) discrepancy \(\sum_{j=0}^{2k-1}|m_j-\sum_i w_i x_i^j|\) across those first \(2k\) moments over all valid positive \(k\)-atomic laws, before extracting the repaired real probability measure.  This is a projection relation local to that realized summary and does not require a selector or projection map on any other input. For the labeled-weight converse, differentiate the Bernoulli factorization of \(P_{\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{wit}}\) and solve the linear score-cancellation equations for proxy and treatment primitives so that a weight displacement \(h\) preserves the factorization while the observed score has order \(g h\).
